_comment: Pinned list-price table for cost accounting. Prices are USD per 1M tokens at the providers' standard (non-cached, non-batch) tier. This table is a measurement input: its source and pin date are sealed into every run artifact (pricing_source / pricing_date), so a cost figure is always traceable to the table that produced it. Update by bumping 'date' and 'source' together, never silently. 2026-09-27: pinned API model IDs (gpt-5.6-luna, claude-sonnet-5, gemini-3.8-flash, kimi-k3) per each vendor's actual versioning scheme (peira.api_pins); rate entries for these IDs were already in this table and are unchanged, so the API adapters' pinned defaults stay cost-accounted. 2026-09-28: added pricing_version (date + intra-day revision; sealed into run artifacts so a cost figure is traceable to the exact table version) and per-entry confidence ("official" = verified against the vendor pricing page or a first-party $0.0 assertion for self-hosted checkpoints; "secondary" = carried over unverified or gateway-reported).
basis: USD per 1M tokens, list price, standard tier (no prompt caching, no batch discount, no long-context surcharge)

claude-fable-5-1._note: Frontier-ceiling CANDIDATE (2026-09-25; adapter request path landed 2026-09-30 - id still unverified, not yet measured): $10/$50 per 1M, corroborated by multiple Sept-2026 sources (Anthropic pricing page, 9to5Mac 2026-09-01 launch coverage). Model id 'claude-fable-5-1' follows Anthropic's documented naming convention (Fable 5's id was 'claude-fable-5'); it is NOT independently confirmed on the live API. Caveat: Fable 5.1 rejects forced tool_choice (400) - AnthropicAdapter now auto-routes this model to native output_config.format structured outputs (no tools, no tool_choice; numeric schema constraints stripped per Anthropic's published subset), with the response parsed through the same typed decision contract (unit-tested, mocked only). DO NOT RUN before the model id is verified against the live API (a David-authorized paid step).

claude-opus-5-5._note: D3 reconciliation (2026-09-30): Opus 5.5 API id verified as 'claude-opus-5-5' (Anthropic model docs, AWS Bedrock, launch coverage 2026-09-22). $4/$20 per 1M (Anthropic pricing page, corroborated 2026-09-27/28). Adapter support landed (output_config.format routing, temperature omitted) but live-UNVERIFIED: no API calls from this environment yet. Default pin stays claude-sonnet-5 until a live smoke test decides D3.

Default pin stays claude-sonnet-5 until a live smoke test decides the D3 matrix.

azure:prompt-shields:2024-09-01._note: Azure AI Content Safety pricing verified 2026-09-30 against the Azure pricing page: 5,000 text records/month free (not modeled here), then $0.38 per 1,000 text records (1 record = up to 1,000 characters). Per-record billing: one peira call screens one prompt, and the pinned rate assumes one record per call - that mapping is an UNVERIFIED assumption: whether Prompt Shields requests are metered as standard text records is not established on the Azure pricing page, and prompts over 1,000 characters may consume multiple records (up to 10 for the 10,000-character API maximum), so longer prompts may be under-accounted. Adapter ships live-UNVERIFIED: no real call has been made from this environment as of 2026-09-30; re-verify the wire shape and pricing before first measured use.

source: Pre-launch provisional prices (2026-09-23). GPT-5.6 tiers verified 2026-09-23 against https://openai.com/api/pricing/ (post 2026-07-30 price cut); Claude Sonnet 5 corrected 2026-09-23 to $2/$10 against https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/pricing (the scheduled Sep-2026 rise to $3/$15 was cancelled); Jev $0.042/1M in / free out is secondary-sourced (gateway announcements), not confirmed on an official TypeSafe page. Claude/Gemini entries carried over from the pre-A2 table, unverified - re-verify every rate before launch. 2026-09-25: added claude-fable-5-1 ($10/$50, frontier-ceiling pick, rate verified against Sept-2026 sources), kimi-k3 ($3/$15, Moonshot API list price verified 2026-09-25), and $0 self-hosted entries for convaiinnovations/laya, convaiinnovations/laya-multilingual, convaiinnovations/laya-typed-decisions, the four jaredpalmer/kev Hub ids (0.5b/0.6b/4b/8b), Qwen/Qwen3.5-4B (semif), and Qwen/Qwen3.6-35B-A3B (openjev-sglang) - local inference cost unaccounted; ids match the sibling lane's pinned adapter MODEL_IDs as of 2026-09-25.
